name: [[390,82,38]] cyclic GB divisor code on Z_195, weight-20

provenance.construction: Generalized bicycle (two-block) code on Z_195: H_X=[A|B], H_Z=[B^T|A^T]; a(x) support {0,6,16,31,42,50,85,111,145,153}, b(x) support {0,7,18,32,40,42,75,78,108,117} (weight 10 each, max check weight 20). Both are weight-10 codewords of the cyclic code of the degree-41 divisor g | x^195-1 underlying the [[390,82,30/31/32]] entries, from a 339,893-class harvest of that divisor's light codewords and a 1,403-pair intermediate-band sweep (total support weight 20-28). Distance evidence: profile 38/39/40 at 8M trials x 3 seeds, 39 at pd16-3M, 40 at pd24-3M, 38 at 24M and a fresh pd16 pass -- floor 38 witnessed twice, flat over ~63M RIS trials; the embedded X witness is from the 24M pass (seed 90210), the Z witness is its GB transpose-symmetry image, both machine-verified.
